Supabase JS browser bundle, version 2.117.2, from
https://unpkg.com/@supabase/supabase-js@2.117.2/dist/umd/supabase.js.

It is served locally so the website and OAuth consent page do not depend on a
third-party CDN at runtime. The accompanying MIT license is in
`supabase.LICENSE`.

MentionJS, version 1.0.0, from
https://www.npmjs.com/package/@shelamkoff/mentionjs.
`mention.min.js` and `mention.min.css` are served locally for the chat composer.
The accompanying MIT license is in `mention.LICENSE`.
